subject: Next steps: Arbor Health private hosting constraints & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up and short recap from today — private hosting constraints

Lena — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery call while the details are fresh. Please correct anything I have wrong.

Primary pain / driver
- Regulatory requirement to keep patient PII within Arbor Health networks (data residency + audit trace).
- Board-level mandate for air-gapped staging environments for clinical trials integration.

What we heard about desired end-state
- An inference deployment that:
  - Keeps tokens/video attachments within Arbor VPC and encrypts keys via your HSM (no Redwood-managed keys in plaintext).
  - Supports outbound-only egress (requests initiated to Redwood endpoints via NAT/proxy) OR an on-prem instance behind an internal gateway.
  - Provides audit logs and per-request traces for SOC2/ISO review.

Networking constraints mentioned
- No inbound connections from public IPs to compute in the sensitive subnet.
- No persistent peering to third-party networks — prefer private express route + strict ACLs.
- Allowed egress only through a set of proxies; mutual TLS accepted.

Immediate asks we agreed on
1) We will send a short network sketch (attached) and a matrix of deployment options (hosted-dedicated vs on-prem) with tradeoffs for latency, cost, and compliance.
2) Arbor to share any existing HSM/KMS vendor details and contact for security questionnaire (Lena, thanks for offering to loop security).
3) Technical deep-dive scheduled: Wed Jun 14 10:00am PT — please confirm attendees.

Attachments: arbor_network_sketch.png (stencil), redwood-deployment-options.pdf (brief)

Next steps (from Redwood)
- Ben: updated options matrix and a short checklist for the network team by Monday 06/12.
- Rachel: draft answers to the initial security questionnaire and example SOC2 artifacts we can surface.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arborhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Arbor Health Security <security@arborhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up and short recap from today — private hosting constraints

Ben — this captures the high level well. A few clarifications from our side:

1) HSM/KMS: we use Azure Key Vault with HSM-backed keys (BYOK option enabled). Security will want to confirm key import/rotation processes.
2) Egress model: outbound-only via a set of hardened proxies is preferred. We cannot permit any inbound public endpoints to the subnet that touches PHI.
3) Audit: we need request-level metadata retained for 12 months and logs retained (immutable) for 3 years for clinical audit.

Security will send the completed initial questionnaire by EOD Tue 6/13 (cc'd them here). Tom from infra will join the Wed deep-dive.

On the procurement side — procurement wants a timeline and a ballpark CAPEX/OPEX split for an on-prem deployment vs Redwood Dedicated. If you can include that in the options matrix, it would help accelerate internal approvals.

—Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director, IT Security & Compliance, Arbor Health
lena.ortiz@arborhealth.com

Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up and short recap from today — private hosting constraints

Ben — flagging a couple of items for the deep-dive:
- We should prepare two network patterns: (A) outbound-only hosted with controlled proxy egress + customer-managed KMS via BYOK, and (B) on-prem containerized bundle deployed into their private cluster with an outbound telemetry tunnel to our control plane.
- Include expected support SLAs and what log retention looks like for each (we may need paid add-on for 3y immutable retention).
- Run the latency estimate for inference at their expected load (they mentioned 200 concurrent sessions, average prompt length 120 tokens).

I'll join the Wed call and handle SOW/contract overview after the tech acceptability is confirmed.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Private Deployments, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellison <tom.ellison@arborhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Arbor Health Security <security@arborhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up and short recap from today — private hosting constraints

Quick note from Infra (Tom) after reviewing the sketch:
- We can support outbound-only via an approved NAT/proxy cluster. Will need a short allowlist for egress FQDNs and mTLS certs for mutual auth.
- On-prem option: we run Kubernetes clusters air-gapped for trials; install path needs to avoid pulling images from public registries. Can we provide an offline image bundle and install checklist?
- Procurement timeline looks like: expect 6 weeks for initial procurement approval once options + ballpark numbers are in front of leadership.

I'll be on the deep-dive Wed.

Tom Ellison
Senior Cloud Architect, Arbor Health
